728-1981-2415-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-8319.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4359-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2111-4659-6982.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-5711-6965.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-1115-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1115-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

457-3490-7742.description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Urza's first ability by tapping an artifact you control, adding {U}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1768-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
1768-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
When the Cats enter, Juniper Order Ranger triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Cat and two +1/+1 counters on Juniper Order Ranger.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

1170-2440-4055-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
1170-2440-4055-7577.description:
Cast the copy of Swords to Plowshares from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Emeritus of Truce.
When Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares enters, it and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Emeritus of Truce trigger, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Inkling creature token with flying and preparing Emeritus of Truce.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C} since Displacer Kitten and Emeritus of Truce are both Cats.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares, exiling a creature an opponent controls and causing them to gain life.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat any number of times.
If the board state allows, create an Inkling token in step 4 instead of targeting an opponent.
1170-2440-4055-7577.notes: The exact results depend on the board state, but you should typically be able to reach a point where an opponent has more creatures than you and get the most beneficial combination of results.

4311-4871-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4311-4871-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

147-6797-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

618-4344-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

339-677-3499-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1987-2364-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

671-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-4017-4186.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater

224-3784-6657.easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand. You are able to play a land this turn.
224-3784-6657.description:
Play any land, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Retreat to Coralhelm abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

2452-3249-3845-5670--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-3845-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1117-2350-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2438-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

3525-6006-6210.notablePrerequisites: Neerdiv does not have summoning sickness.
3525-6006-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

2254-2556-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
2254-2556-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Mnemonic Wall's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Mnemonic Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1661-2510-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1247-4474-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-4474-4893.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2757-4365-5189.notablePrerequisites:
There is a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control at least one basic land.
2757-4365-5189.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling, untapping a basic land.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

1410-1544-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
1410-1544-4740.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Captain Rex Nebula triggers, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become a Vehicle artifact with crew 2.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir's crew ability by tapping Captain Rex Nebula, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Vampiric Link by paying {B}, targeting Aetherflux Reservoir.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Vampiric Link, attaching it to Aetherflux Reservoir.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Vampiric Link trigger.
Resolve the Vampiric Link trigger, causing you to gain fifty life.
Repeat from step 6.

151-3789-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-3789-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-3789-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

345-1486-1651.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Metallic Mimic and another artifact, targeting Metallic Mimic.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Metallic Mimic.
Repeat.
